decode_gate.throughput_formula: sum(actual successful output tokens) / continuous measurement window wall seconds

prerequisites: zero errors or failed measurement requests
control identities equal across the two control processes
candidate identities equal across the two candidate processes

dispositions.QUALIFIED_REQUEST_GAIN: all correctness, resource, primary and protection gates pass in both pairs
dispositions.MEASURED_NO_PROMOTION: complete valid evidence but one or more performance/protection gates fail
dispositions.REJECTED_CORRECTNESS_OR_RESOURCE: complete evidence contains an explicit correctness/state/cancel/resource failure
dispositions.ComparisonValidationError: incomplete or incomparable evidence; must not be relabeled NO_GAIN
